This dog lost all four paws… then helped people find the strength to keep going. Meet Chi Chi, a golden retriever rescued in South Korea after being found abandoned in a trash bag, her legs tightly bound. Her injuries were so severe that veterinarians had to amputate part of all four legs to save her life. But her story was only beginning. The Howell family in Arizona adopted Chi Chi, giving her love, patient care, and custom prosthetic legs. Slowly, she learned to walk again, and trust people again. She even became a certified therapy dog, comforting others and inspiring people facing challenges of their own. In 2018, she was named America’s Hero Dog. Once abandoned, Chi Chi became someone people looked to for hope.
